metadata.name: Path of Ruin: Nehemiah's Usurpance
metadata.description:
Journey through The Basement as Nehemiah, a new character for Isaac to cosplay.
[h1] Nehemiah [/h1]
Play The Binding of Isaac: Repentance with a new twist! | Nehemiah is a rock focused character, cracking open rocks for grabbable chunks which deal big damage! | With Nehemiah's signature item, "Nehemiah's Hammer", You can carve out these rocks or just use the hammer as a melee weapon.
[h1] Tainted Nehemiah ("The Condemned") [/h1]
When playing as Tainted Nehemiah, you lose Nehemiah's signature hammer, in favor of an old locked book. | This new item, "The Book of Ezra", gives Isaac a fading buff when standing in the light it shines. | Tainted Nehemiah's book also has some secret interactions when used in a certain room...
[h1] Unlockables [/h1]
Nehemiah has a whopping 15 unlocks, and Tainted Nehemiah has 7! | There are some items that start unlocked, and some that I've kept out of circulation due to being on the buggy side
[h1] Credits [/h1]
Team Ruin: Karkaton: Creator, Programmer, Creative Designer, Artist, Room Designer Cable_Guy: Artist, Tester Disashterous: Tester
Other: Ferpe: Artist Ridiculon: Voice Lines
[h1] Download Mirror [/h1]
https://github.com/Karkaton-V/PathofRuin
[h1] Bug Reporting/Contact [/h1]
If you've encountered bugs or compatibility issues, PLEASE let me know at any of these contacts below. | Please be warned, this is my first big mod for Isaac so bug fixes might take me some time.
Discord: @karkavon Instagram: @tboi_pathofruin
Feel free to also leave a comment here, and I hope you enjoy Wave 1 of Path of Ruin, Nehemiah's Usurpance! *Make sure to check the update logs and my instagram! When major updates release, I'll post them there!
